conclusion: The D-006 go threshold (>=3 graph-only incidents or >=20% of sampled cross-workspace reds) is NOT DEMONSTRATED. The qualified population holds one verified cross-workspace red (WI-10001699) and the pre-change static index already caught it. Read this as 'no demonstrated graph-only value in this window', never as 'proven no value'.

qualification.method: Each lexical candidate and repair-attributed id was read (title + summary + body). An incident enters the population only when its own record names a breaking change and a failing test in a DIFFERENT workspace (cross-workspace-red), or a code-caller absence claim that was later retracted (retracted-absence). The rest are tool friction, reflections, scope/identity issues or detector false positives, not breakage incidents.
